Why it matters

Uncooked rice can contain spores of Bacillus cereus, which survive cooking. At room temperature they can germinate and produce toxins that reheating won’t destroy.

What experts recommend

  • Cool rice within one hour of cooking
  • Store it in the fridge at or below 5°C
  • Eat leftovers within 24 hours
  • Reheat only once, until steaming hot

The bottom line

If your rice has been out overnight, the safest choice is to throw it away.
